ruleset.name: framework-baseline
ruleset.description:
Baseline PMD ruleset for this framework's Java code. Complements checkstyle-magic-numbers.xml rather than duplicating it: Checkstyle here is about naming/magic-values/dead-catch, PMD's job below is best-practice and error-prone patterns that a naming-and-formatting tool doesn't cover.
Verified against a deliberately bad Java file during this framework's audit -- AvoidLiteralsInIfCondition and SystemPrintln both fired as expected. PMD's default profiles for these categories are large (>50 rules each); this file references the categories wholesale rather than hand-picking rule names, so coverage grows automatically as PMD adds rules to these categories in future releases. A project's own pmd-ruleset.xml at the repo root takes precedence over this file (see framework/gates/g4_executable.sh); this is the fallback baseline.
Note: neither PMD nor Checkstyle reliably catches a hardcoded credential whose variable name doesn't match an obvious pattern -- that's what the gitleaks pass in g4_executable.sh is for (verified: it catches known secret *formats* regardless of variable name; PMD/Checkstyle catch naming-heuristic and structural issues instead).
